manual.charging_station.line2: {0}The Charging Station is a device that allows you to charge tools and other items that can accept energy.{1}
manual.charging_station.line3: Power can be input through the bottom or the back and items can be placed in manually or inserted automatically.{0}
manual.charging_station.line4: The electron tubes at the front give a feedback about the charge fraction of the item.{0}
manual.charging_station.line5: Comparators can be used to read the current charge fraction of the item as a redstone signal.{0}
